content:
Overview

Prescott is a city in AZ with a population of 47,000. Historic Arizona town with Whiskey Row, pine forests, and a vibrant retirement community. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews older, with a median age of 60.3.
